name: App Manager Remover
description: A unified application manager that lists user-installed apps from Flatpak, Snap, and Deb sources with one-click uninstall. Hides system components using a 6-layer filtering strategy. A 'Base' tab exposes common core GNOME apps (Calendar, Contacts, Maps, Weather, Clocks...) hidden by default, and a 'Packages' tab surfaces manually-installed deb packages with no .desktop launcher (CLI tools, Nautilus scripts...). Uninstallation is confirmed via a modal dialog and authenticated through pkexec (PolicyKit).
